og_title:
North York Smile Centre on Instagram: "Clear aligners only work when you wear them consistently. 🦷

For Invisalign treatment, wearing your aligners for around 20 to 22 hours a day helps keep your tooth movement progressing according to your treatment plan.

That means keeping them in throughout the day and night, and removing them mainly for eating, drinking anything other than water, brushing, and flossing.

Consistency is one of the most important parts of staying on track with clear aligner treatment.

#SmileCentre #Invisalign #ClearAligners #InvisalignTreatment #StraightTeeth #Orthodontics #DentalCare #HealthySmile"
